## Services
- Web Development — custom websites and platforms (Next.js, React), fast, responsive, SEO- and conversion-focused
- E-commerce — complete storefronts with payments, inventory, order tracking, and analytics
- Mobile Apps — native and cross-platform (iOS, Android), concept to app store
- Custom Software — bespoke systems, dashboards, and automation around exact business workflows
- CRM Systems — centralised customer data, automated sales pipelines
- ERP Solutions — finance, inventory, HR, and operations unified in one platform
- AI Agents — assistants, automated workflows, and AI integrations
- UI/UX & Brand — visual identities, design systems, and interfaces

## Process
1. Discovery — analyze the ecosystem, users, and market gaps
2. Strategy — roadmap, milestones, technical architecture
3. Design — high-fidelity prototypes balancing aesthetics and UX
4. Development — clean, scalable, modular code on modern infrastructure
5. Launch — deployment, monitoring, and ongoing evolution
